cast.title: Sex and Zen III
cast.overview: New prostitutes Susan, Fanny, and Chinyun are inducted into the Fragrance House brothel where they are trained in the ways of lovemaking by their veteran madam Tall Kau. Eventually all three enter circulation where Susan is crowned the top prize and becomes enamored of budding scholar Chu Chi-Ang. Fanny is jealous beyond all means and though she's bought by famous horse trader Sir Lui, she still plans her revenge on Susan.

cast.title: The Fruit Is Swelling
cast.overview: An 8-year-old girl named Peach makes a wish and wakes up to find herself transformed into an 18-year-old woman.

cast.title: Haunted Karaoke
cast.overview: Two police officers follow a suspect into a karaoke bar. Only it is far from a typical bar. Turns out the venue burnt down years earlier, and the teenage partygoers are really spirits who want the cops to help in tracking down the arsonists responsible.

cast.title: Chinese Erotic Ghost Story
cast.overview: Chu is a lowly debt collector for the local strongman Wang. Problem is that Chu is too nice/honest/dopey to be very good at the grubby collections job. Chu is treated badly by his boss Wang. Eventually Wang catches one of his twin daughters in the act of seducing the hapless bumpkin Chu. Wang naturally blames Chu rather than the daughter. For punishment Wang sends Chu on an impossible quest to Satan's Temple to steal a statue of Judge Lu.

cast.title: Raped by an Angel 2: The Uniform Fan
cast.overview: A dentist obsessed with young women in uniform stalks two sisters. Yue Po Wan, the older sister, is a policewoman who is romantically pursued by a thug just released from prison. Jenny, the younger sister, is a schoolgirl and a girl-guide - and has been invited along with all her schoolfriends to the dentist's holiday home.

cast.title: Anna Magdalena
cast.overview: Two young men fall for the woman staying upstairs when she practises J.S. Bach's "Notebook for Anna Magdalena".
